Boardroom

The contemporary boardroom on the second floor is perfectly suited to meetings. It looks out over the classical formal garden on one side and the cityscape on the other. A large projection screen is an integral feature, and two break-out rooms sit on the same floor. Ever-changing contemporary art hangs in the boardroom.

Salons

The salons on the first floor look out over the surrounding gardens. The fireplace in the grand salon was originally located in the mayoral residence, and the ceiling carries the earliest rococo stuccowork in the Netherlands. The grand, striking salons are truly exceptional venues — from meetings to private dinners.

Garden room

The garden room on the first floor was added in the 18th century and looks out over the formal garden through windows on three sides. A unique and inspirational space for a private meeting or dinner, and a favourite break-out room.

Coach house

The coach house most resembles an atmospheric farmstead in the middle of the city. The possibilities are endless: a mobile bar allows for events both in and outdoors, and the coverable patio next to the coach house belongs exclusively to the space.
